state-symbol.def: A label after a formula that says how the species exists: (s) solid, (l) liquid, (g) gas, (aq) dissolved in water.

limiting-reactant.def: The limiting reactant is the one that runs out first and so sets how much product can form; any reactant left over is in excess (the excess reactant).

reaction-diagram.def: A drawing of the particles before and after a reaction. It conserves every atom, and the change in particle counts shows the ratio given by the coefficients.
